remarks: Nicely maintained 3 bedrooms/ 2 full bathroom home w/ maintenance free vinyl exterior!   No neighbors across the street!   What a location! So close to Stiglmeier Park which is a park that has about 257 acres w/ over 10 miles of trails, including the Losson Trail (4.5 miles), Reinstein Nature Preserve, Hawthorn Hollow, Cayuga Creek, and other scenic routes, playgrounds, picnic shelters, and a Krasner Center with trail maps.    Comes w/ a 3 CAR GARAGE such a nice bonus feature for car lovers and hobby enthusiasts!   Covered front porch with rod iron railings nice for hanging flowers and plants and wrap around resealed blacktop driveway!   Large living room w/ lots of natural sunlight! Formal dining room perfect for gatherings! ###Living room and formal dining room just freshly repainted to neutral color! Large EAT IN kitchen w/lots of cabinets, has a Lazy Susan cabinet, updated stainless steel sink, updated vinyl flooring, comes w/ BRAND NEW GAS STOVE, refrigerator and range hood. Full bathroom w/updated touch light up mirror, new flooring and new cabinet! A small bedroom w/closet completed this 1st floor!   2nd floor has 2 large bedrooms w/ ample closet space, wall to wall carpeting and ceiling fans! Upstairs you will also find another full bathroom w/ tub/shower combo and large bathroom vanity!  Full basement, 100-amp electrical box and has Lennox forced air for heat and Rheem water tank! Some of the recent updates are new glass block windows in basement w/ vents, some floorings, some light fixtures, some updates to bathrooms, some plumbing and electrical work, roof over house with left side being a total tear off, resealed blacktop driveway, water tank.  Buyer to accept existing survey date 4/2/2026 with affidavit from seller stating that nothing has changed.
